text: Danke, sehr. Dieses App hat mir meinen Leben verändert.
author: enes752 / Science of Kingdom /
developer_reply: Oh wow, love to hear it! We get this a lot and it's always so brilliant to hear! Glad to see Yoodoo has been transformative for you :) - keep up the daily focus!

text: super schöne Farbauswahl und Verknüpfung mit Google Kalender mag ich sehr. ich hab mich jetzt nur wegen cutem Design für etwas anderes entschieden, aber werde diese im Hinterkopf behalten. Testphase ist möglich und der Preis ist auch fair.
author: Lilli Corleona
developer_reply: Thanks for giving Yoodoo a try. Glad you liked the colors + Google Calendar sync! Totally get the pull of cute design, maybe we’ll get cuter in the future.

text: Ich finde die App sehr übersichtlich und praktisch. Sie lässt sich einfach und intuitiv nutzen. Auf jeden Fall die beste App, die ich zur Planung meiner Tage bisher gefunden habe. Wünschen würde ich mir, dass Aufgaben, die ich in den Kalender eintrage, auch in der Todo-Liste auftauchen. Und eine große Bitte: Könnt ihr eine Möglichkeit einrichten, das Banner unten im Tagesplan auszuschalten? Mich lenkt das ab.
author: kreativer Kanalname
developer_reply:
Yoooooo. So to get calendar tasks in your tasklist, just tap ‘add to tasklist’ tickbox under the task name when editing it.
And yep, that ‘make a plan today’ banner is getting a toggle soon - th eone for the morning 'Plan your day'. But the main one (5/10, leave no task behind) is staying put - for now. You don't find it useful?

text: der free plan ist zu eingeschränkt um eine Idee zu bekommen ob die APP was ist. außerdem ist das erstellen der aufgaben umständlich und hat für mich keine gute Aufschlüsselung für Unteraufgaben.
author: Trüffelschwein
developer_reply: Thanks for the feedback! I designed task-adding to be super fast: tap the quick-add, type, and done! The free plan offers unlimited tasks, focus timer, reschedule, tonnes more AND a 7-day Pro trial. Task breakdown is also just one tap for easy/medium/hard. What specific improvements did you have in mind to make it even simpler?

text: ich bin ich sehr angetan von dieser App. Nicht nur was sie alles bietet (und bieten wird) ,sondern auch dass man das aktiv mitgestalten kann und großes Plus: dass sie keine Daten speichert und weitergibt!!!!
author: Nane
developer_reply: Hi Nane. Thank you so much for your review. Yes, all the data is yours and you can help shape it. Pretty sweet right! Thanks for supporting.

text: Really good combination of todos and day planner. Extra features like day templates, common tasks or regular habits complete the scope. You have lists to group your todos and look for the right one at the right moment. Open todo counter is currently wrong but hopefully that will be fixed soon. Response from the developer was really fast that they know about it.
author: Tobias H.
developer_reply: Hi Tobias, the counter should have fixed, though we are still having issues with the 'all tasks' counter, but that'll get fixed soon enough. Hopefully you can bare with that bug a little longer. Glad you are enjoying Yoodoo otherwise :)

text: leider nur auf Englisch sonst wäre sie ideal
author: Jessica Frank
developer_reply: Hi Jessica. We are bringing new languages to the app very soon (German, Spanish & French) so hopefully this will make it perfect for you. Thanks for highlighting this to me. Ross

text: I'm exploring the app and like it so far. Is it possible to add context actions to the app symbol on the main screen, via tap & hold? I'd really like to quick-add tasks this way.
author: Maik Bode
developer_reply: Hi Maik. Thanks for dropping us a review. Ok got ya. So as in a quick-add direct to the app Icon on the homescreen? You know that's something I hadn't considered before, but it's a great idea! Let me add that to the roadmap for the next release. Watch this space. Glad you are enjoying Yoodoo so far :)

text: Another example of predatory monetization. If ethical apps or Products exist these days, this isn't one of them. Only 5 tasks available in free mode. I considered starting a trial and maybe even paying if I'm satisfied, but not after seeing they demand a payment method up front, trying to get you to pay against your will out of forgetfulness, which ADHDers are ESPECIALLY prone to. Even more devious than modern videogames. Vultures preying on the weak
author: Froh Natur
developer_reply: Hi Froh. We have a 7 day trial so you can try the PRO version for free, and on Google play you can always get a refund if you're not happy with the app. Plus we have a monthly version which is only $4, so you can try it out a month for literally the price of a coffee. You can also set a reminder IN THE APP - which is kinda what it was made for.
